name: Samba Tatenaka
caption: Billed "The Pride of Japan," entered Twilight Slams' own delegation to the alliance's New Era supercard and was eliminated from its fifteen-man Global Championship match by a top-rope legdrop, moments after clearing eleven men out of the ring in one blow.

tenures.role: wrestler — billed for TS's own delegation to the alliance's New Era supercard, in the Global Championship match
tenures.source: /promotions/ptc/archive/new-era-2003-superstars.html (the delegation roster, under a "Twilight Slams Wrestling" heading) and /promotions/ptc/archive/new-era-2003-results.html (the results, which stage him wrestling and being eliminated)

notes: Named twice more, both times only as a rumor: Primetime Central's own newsdesk of 29 January 2003 (/promotions/ptc/archive/news-2003-01.html) speculates he may be the new wrestler TS's incoming Vice President was set to debut, and separately reports he "was supposed to enter" at a pay-per-view called "Hell in Your House" — neither speculation is ever confirmed, and no TS-held document mentions him at all. Only the New Era supercard (a PTC-held document, not a TS one) actually stages him.

name: Laguna

portrays.note: The fed's own buildup roleplay for this bout (PTC's New Era board, "Meeting Laguna the Soldier [Extreme #1]") narrates him in the first person by the same name, armed with a machine gun, leading a two-man unit of Kiros and Ward — Final Fantasy VIII's Laguna Loire and his own crew, played straight.

caption: Entered Twilight Slams' own delegation to the alliance's New Era supercard, fighting into the small hours of its Steel Mill Extreme Cluster match — including a turn against his own delegation-mate NecroWraith — before the surviving account loses track of him.

name: NecroWraith
caption: Entered Twilight Slams' own delegation to the alliance's New Era supercard and opened its Steel Mill Extreme Cluster match by clearing eleven men out with one explosion from a catwalk, fighting through most of the field before Iron Lung put him out with a dragon sleeper as one of the match's own final four.
